Pre-visualise a NONMEM-like dataset

Source: R/nm_data_previsual.R
nm_data_previsual.Rd

Pre-visualise a NONMEM-like dataset

Usage

nm_data_previsual(
  file,
  sep = ",",
  na = c("", "NA", "."),
  time_unit = c("h", "d"),
  reconstruct_time = FALSE,
  clock_col = NULL,
  date_type = NULL,
  dv_col = NULL,
  strat = NULL,
  ci_probs = c(0.05, 0.95),
  dose_norm = FALSE,
  scales = c("linear", "log", "both"),
  cmt = NULL,
  xlim = NULL,
  blq_handling = c("show", "exclude", "half_lloq", "keep"),
  lloq = NULL,
  blq_col = NULL,
  export_jpg = FALSE,
  export_csv = FALSE,
  output_dir = NULL,
  jpg_width = 9,
  jpg_height = 5,
  jpg_dpi = 300,
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

file

Path to the CSV file (or an already loaded data.frame).

sep

Column separator (default ",").

na

Strings to be treated as missing values.

time_unit

Output unit for TIME: "h" (default) or "d".

reconstruct_time

If TRUE, rebuild a relative TIME (t0 = first dose per subject) from a clock-time column and, optionally, a DATE column. If FALSE (default), the TIME column is used as is (as.numeric). Detecting a DATE/DAT1/DAT2/DAT3 column NEVER triggers the reconstruction automatically.

clock_col

Name of the column holding the clock time (hh:mm:ss, hh:mm or decimal hours), used when reconstruct_time = TRUE. NULL (default) = column "TIME".

date_type

How the DATE column is interpreted during the reconstruction (only if reconstruct_time = TRUE):

  • NULL (default): clock time only, anchored on a single day

  • "continuous": DATE = integer day counter (1, 2, 3...)

  • "DATE": calendar date month-day-year (mm-dd-yy)

  • "DAT1": calendar date day-month-year (dd-mm-yy)

  • "DAT2": calendar date year-month-day (yy-mm-dd)

  • "DAT3": calendar date year-day-month (yy-dd-mm)

dv_col

Name of the DV column to use (manual override).

strat

Name of a stratification column for the plot (e.g. "DOSE", "OCC", "STUDY"). NULL = none.

ci_probs

Two quantiles defining the interval band around the median (default c(0.05, 0.95), i.e. a 90% interval).

dose_norm

If TRUE, also compute DV_norm = DV / AMT (dose given to the subject) and produce the matching plot. Requires an identified AMT column.

scales

"linear", "log" or "both": Y axes produced. "both" gives side-by-side linear and log panels (patchwork).

cmt

CMT value(s) to keep for the plot. Requires an identified CMT column. NULL (default) = all observed compartments (CMT != 0 when EVID is available). E.g. cmt = 2 for the central compartment.

xlim

X-axis limits c(min, max). NULL (default) = full data range.

blq_handling

How BLQ values are handled:

  • "show" (default): BLQ drawn as grey crosses below a dashed line at LLOQ; excluded from the median and quantiles

  • "exclude": BLQ removed from the plot and statistics

  • "half_lloq": DV replaced by LLOQ/2 (requires lloq)

  • "keep": nothing done, plotted as is

lloq

Numeric LLOQ. Needed to identify BLQ records when no flag column is found, and for "half_lloq". NULL = no threshold.

blq_col

Name of the censoring flag column (1 = BLQ, 0 = quantified). If NULL, auto-detected among "BLQ", "BQL", "LLQ", "CENS".

export_jpg

If TRUE, export the plots as JPG files in output_dir.

export_csv

If TRUE, export the final data.frame (relative TIME, DV_norm) as CSV in output_dir.

output_dir

Output directory (default: directory of the source file). Formerly out_dir, still accepted with a warning.

jpg_width

Width in inches of the JPG export (default 9).

jpg_height

Height in inches of the JPG export (default 5).

jpg_dpi

Resolution in dpi (default 300).

verbose

Print the identification report (default TRUE).

...

Former argument name, accepted with a warning until version 1.0: out_dir (now output_dir).

Value

An object of class nm_data_previsual (a list, printed as a short summary):

  • data: data.frame with TIME (relative if rebuilt) and DV_norm

  • mapping: reserved labels -> original column names

  • plot_dv: ggplot of DV vs TIME (according to scales)

  • plot_norm: ggplot of DV/dose vs TIME (NULL if dose_norm = FALSE)

  • summary: diagnostic data.frame (N subjects, N obs, time range, % BLQ...)

  • files: paths of the written files (NULL if nothing was exported)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# TIME already numeric/relative: used as is (default behaviour)
res <- nm_data_previsual("data.csv")

# Rebuild from a clock-time column TIME_R + DATE = day counter
res <- nm_data_previsual("data.csv", reconstruct_time = TRUE,
                         clock_col = "TIME_R", date_type = "continuous")

# Rebuild from a calendar DATE in day-month-year order (DAT1)
res <- nm_data_previsual("data.csv", reconstruct_time = TRUE,
                         clock_col = "TIME", date_type = "DAT1")

res <- nm_data_previsual("data.csv", strat = "DOSE", dose_norm = TRUE,
                         scales = "both", lloq = 0.5, export_jpg = TRUE)
print(res$plot_dv); print(res$summary)
} # }
